meta.name: Hoard CTI
meta.description: The public roadmap for Hoard CTI, an open-source cyber threat intelligence feed.

roadmaps.title: Roadmap
roadmaps.summary: Where Hoard CTI is going: the programme-level view across every repository and feed.

intro.heading: Overview
intro.body: Hoard CTI is built as a set of small, independent repositories that each own one slice of the pipeline. This page tracks the programme milestones; each splintered roadmap below tracks the delivery detail for its own repository.

callout.title: Automatically generated
callout.body: This page is rendered from a single JSON file that CI updates whenever issues and milestones change.

milestones.title: Foundations
milestones.description: The base platform: storage contracts, schemas and the shared tooling every collector builds on.

items.title: Indicator schema v1
items.description: A stable, versioned document shape for indicators, actors and sources.

items.title: Storage contract
items.description: A single read/write interface so backends can be swapped without touching collectors.

items.title: CI baseline
items.description: Shared lint, test and release workflows published as reusable GitHub Actions.

milestones.title: Collection at scale
milestones.description: Broaden the source coverage and make ingest resilient to flaky upstreams.

items.title: Collector SDK
items.description: A thin library that handles retries, rate limits, checkpointing and provenance for new scrapers.

items.title: Cross-source deduplication
items.description: Merge identical indicators seen across feeds while preserving every source reference.

items.title: Historical backfill
items.description: Replay archived source snapshots into the current schema.

milestones.title: Enrichment & context
milestones.description: Turn raw indicators into intelligence with scoring, clustering and lightweight AI summaries.

items.title: Confidence scoring
items.description: A transparent, reproducible score per indicator based on source agreement and recency.

items.title: AI campaign summaries
items.description: Cluster related indicators and generate a short, citation-backed narrative per campaign.

items.title: Actor attribution hints
items.description: Link clusters to known actor aliases without asserting attribution outright.

milestones.title: Distribution
milestones.description: Make the feed trivial to consume from anything: files, API, or a SIEM connector.

items.title: STIX 2.1 bundles
items.description: Publish signed STIX bundles alongside the native JSON feed.

items.title: Read-only public API
items.description: Cached, rate-limited HTTP API served from the edge with no authentication required.

items.title: SIEM connectors
items.description: First-party connectors for the common open-source SIEM and TIP platforms.

roadmaps.title: Storage
roadmaps.summary: Durable, cheap, queryable storage for indicators and their provenance.

milestones.title: Core backend
milestones.description: The default object-storage backend and its index.

items.title: Object store layout
items.description: Partitioned, append-only layout with immutable daily snapshots.

items.title: Lookup index
items.description: Compact index for point lookups by indicator value and type.

milestones.title: Scale & retention
milestones.description: Keep the archive affordable as the feed grows.

items.title: Snapshot compaction
items.description: Roll daily snapshots into monthly parquet archives.

items.title: Retention policies
items.description: Per-source retention windows with hard-delete guarantees.

items.title: Pluggable backends
items.description: Reference adapters for S3-compatible stores and local disk.

roadmaps.title: Ingest
roadmaps.summary: Normalising, deduplicating and validating everything that arrives from collectors.

milestones.title: Pipeline v1
milestones.description: A deterministic pipeline from raw payload to stored document.

items.title: Normalisation stage
items.description: Map every source payload onto the shared indicator schema.

items.title: Schema validation
items.description: Reject or quarantine malformed documents with an actionable error.

milestones.title: Data quality
milestones.description: Trustworthy output: fewer duplicates, fewer false positives.

items.title: Deduplication engine
items.description: Content-addressed merge that keeps every source reference intact.

items.title: Allowlist filtering
items.description: Drop well-known benign infrastructure before it reaches the feed.

items.title: Quarantine review queue
items.description: A reviewable holding area for documents that fail validation.

roadmaps.title: Scrapers & Collectors
roadmaps.summary: The fleet of small, independent collectors that feed the pipeline.

milestones.title: Collector SDK
milestones.description: Shared behaviour so a new collector is a config file and a parser.

items.title: Retries & rate limiting
items.description: Backoff, jitter and per-host budgets handled by the SDK.

items.title: Checkpointing
items.description: Resume interrupted runs without re-fetching everything.

items.title: Provenance capture
items.description: Record the exact URL, fetch time and hash for every document.

milestones.title: Source coverage
milestones.description: Broaden the feed beyond the initial launch sources.

items.title: Phishing feeds
items.description: Collectors for the major community phishing trackers.

items.title: Malware sample metadata
items.description: Hash and family metadata from public sample repositories.

items.title: Community collectors
items.description: A contribution guide and review process for third-party collectors.
items.note: Waiting on the Collector SDK to stabilise.

roadmaps.title: Automation
roadmaps.summary: Serverless schedules, policies and the lightweight AI workflows that run unattended.

milestones.title: Scheduled runs
milestones.description: Every collector on a schedule with observability built in.

items.title: Serverless scheduler
items.description: Per-collector cron definitions committed alongside the collector.

items.title: Run health dashboard
items.description: Public status page showing last run, duration and document counts.

milestones.title: AI workflows
milestones.description: Narrow, auditable AI steps — never a black box over the whole feed.

items.title: Report triage
items.description: Extract indicators from long-form vendor reports with citations back to the source text.

items.title: Guardrails & evals
items.description: A fixed eval set so model or prompt changes never silently regress the feed.

roadmaps.title: API & Feeds
roadmaps.summary: How consumers actually get the data: files, API endpoints and platform connectors.

milestones.title: Static feeds
milestones.description: Zero-infrastructure consumption straight from object storage.

items.title: Daily JSON export
items.description: A single, compressed daily file with the full indicator set.

items.title: Delta feeds
items.description: Hourly additions and removals for consumers that poll frequently.

milestones.title: Query API
milestones.description: A read-only API for lookups that do not warrant downloading the whole feed.

items.title: Indicator lookup
items.description: Point lookups by value with source references and confidence.

items.title: Faceted search
items.description: Filter by source, type, tag and first-seen window.

items.title: Client libraries
items.description: Generated clients for Python, Go and TypeScript.
